forbidden_interpretation: Do not stitch versions or interpret same-quarter differences as commercial growth.
limitations: The difference is a reporting-definition effect, not growth, a correction, or a restatement.
quantitative_summary: Lineage M: KRW 6,797–13,455m, 5.6%–12.8% versus legacy; six Lineage 2M/Lineage W pairs: zero.
statement_en: Across the 2025Q2–2025Q4 overlaps, Lineage M's royalty-integrated figures exceeded the legacy figures by KRW 6.797–13.455 billion (5.6%–12.8%); the corresponding differences for Lineage 2M and Lineage W were zero.
statement_zh: 在 2025Q2–2025Q4 的同季度重叠中，Lineage M 的 royalty-integrated 数值比 legacy 高 67.97亿–134.55亿韩元（5.6%–12.8%）；Lineage 2M 与 Lineage W 的对应差异为零。
title_zh: 同一季度，报告口径也会改变数值
uncertainty_note: No estimate interval; uncertainty is definitional and versions remain separate.

forbidden_interpretation: This does not prove that the PC launch caused the increase or quantify PC-specific revenue.
limitations: The publisher-defined IP total combines platform receipts and does not disclose a PC-only amount.
quantitative_summary: KRW 7,011.669m → 65,718.814m; QoQ +837.3%; 2025Q2 is the eight-quarter maximum.
statement_en: Stellar Blade IP revenue rose from KRW 7.012 billion in 2025Q1 to KRW 65.719 billion in 2025Q2, an 837.3% quarter-to-quarter increase and the peak of the eight-quarter window, in the same quarter as the PC launch.
statement_zh: Stellar Blade IP 收入从 2025Q1 的 70.12亿韩元升至 2025Q2 的 657.19亿韩元，环比增加 837.3%，并在 PC 上线同季度达到八季度窗口峰值。
title_en: Stellar Blade peaked in its PC-launch quarter
title_zh: Stellar Blade 的 PC 上线季度形成窗口峰值
uncertainty_note: Direct official series; event timing is contextual.

forbidden_interpretation: Do not claim the anniversary caused the rebound or that the remaining gap is permanent.
limitations: The series is publisher-defined IP revenue and the event list is curated, not exhaustive.
statement_en: NIKKE IP revenue increased 32.4% quarter to quarter to KRW 43.266 billion in 2026Q2, but remained 4.1% below the KRW 45.112 billion peak in 2025Q2 and was therefore not recovered within the observed window.
statement_zh: NIKKE IP 收入在 2026Q2 环比增加 32.4% 至 432.66亿韩元，但仍比 2025Q2 的 451.12亿韩元峰值低 4.1%，因此状态是“在观察窗口内尚未恢复”。
title_en: NIKKE rebounded without regaining its prior peak
title_zh: NIKKE 反弹，但尚未回到前高
uncertainty_note: Direct official series; the same-quarter anniversary is context only.

forbidden_interpretation: Do not describe the ending drawdown as a permanent decline.
limitations: This is publisher-defined cross-platform IP revenue over eight quarters; later recovery cannot yet be observed.
quantitative_summary: 69,200 → 54,900 (-20.7%); recovery at 79,500 after 3 quarters; endpoint 55,000 and -30.8%.
statement_en: Black Desert IP revenue fell from the KRW 69.2 billion peak in 2024Q4 to KRW 54.9 billion in 2025Q2 (-20.7%), recovered three quarters after the prior peak at KRW 79.5 billion in 2025Q3, and then ended 2026Q2 at KRW 55.0 billion, 30.8% below the new peak and not recovered within the observed window.
statement_zh: Black Desert IP 收入从 2024Q4 的 692亿韩元峰值回撤至 2025Q2 的 549亿韩元（-20.7%），三季度后在 2025Q3 升至 795亿韩元并恢复；到 2026Q2 又降至 550亿韩元，较新峰值低 30.8%，在观察窗口内尚未恢复。
title_en: Black Desert recovered once, then entered a new drawdown
title_zh: Black Desert 在一次恢复后再次进入回撤
uncertainty_note: Direct official series; no estimate interval.

forbidden_interpretation: Do not stitch the legacy series to v2 or call the observed-window pattern permanent.
limitations: The window contains five quarters and must not be extended backward across the version break.
quantitative_summary: Four consecutive negative QoQ changes; KRW 47,640m → 30,833m; cumulative -35.3%.
statement_en: Within the separate royalty-integrated v2 window, Lineage W declined for four consecutive quarters from KRW 47.640 billion in 2025Q2 to KRW 30.833 billion in 2026Q2, a cumulative decrease of 35.3%, and was not recovered within the observed window.
statement_zh: 在独立的 royalty-integrated v2 窗口内，Lineage W 从 2025Q2 的 476.40亿韩元连续四季下降至 2026Q2 的 308.33亿韩元，累计低 35.3%，且在观察窗口内尚未恢复。
title_en: Lineage W declined for four consecutive quarters under the new definition
title_zh: Lineage W 新口径窗口连续四季下降
uncertainty_note: Direct official series; no estimate interval.

forbidden_interpretation: Do not call issuers unreliable or present sign-sensitive changes as definite directions.
limitations: Applies to deterministic estimates from rounded official shares, not directly reported title revenue.
statement_en: Among 15 comparable quarter-to-quarter changes in the three derived series, 9 (60.0%) change direction within the compatible rounding range; only 6 are directionally stable.
statement_zh: 三个派生序列的 15 个可比较环比中，有 9 个（60.0%）在兼容取整区间内会改变方向，只有 6 个方向稳定。
title_en: Rounded shares make most derived quarter-to-quarter directions indeterminate
title_zh: 取整占比使多数派生环比方向无法确定
uncertainty_note: The finding is an uncertainty result and remains a majority under leave-one-change-out testing.
